html:
SMTO-OBS-0004 — SMTO couldn't find the details for this work

GUID: ebf2016a-6f02-5ee3-a5fa-c4b2aef4ee98
Slug: execution-observation-missing
Domain: OBS · Subsystem: execution

What happened

  • SMTO looked for the saved record of this work in the current conversation and didn't find it. Not finding the record doesn't mean the work failed or never ran.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the page, open the conversation where this Task ran, and expand Inspect execution under that reply. SMTO only shows these details from inside the conversation that owns the work.
  2. If the panel shows Could not refresh execution details, wait for the page to finish loading, then select Retry. Viewing these details only reads saved records, so retrying the view never runs the work again.
  3. If the conversation was deleted, check the files or systems the Task worked on directly instead of starting the Task again. A missing record can't tell you whether the work ran, so starting it again could do it twice.

What success looks like

  • Inspect execution under the reply shows the step's status and timing.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete the conversation or run the Task again to make the details appear.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Execution observation (ExecutionObservation.inspect or the in-memory read) found no retained native run matching the supplied identity within the requested conversation, task, request, operation or job scope, or rejected a malformed locator (empty, non-string or over 200 characters).

What this means

  • Execution observation rejects malformed/insufficient selectors or cannot match the requested conversation/task/request/activity/operation/job ownership and retained evidence. Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.

Why this can happen

  • Execution observation rejects malformed/insufficient selectors or cannot match the requested conversation/task/request/activity/operation/job ownership and retained evidence.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare exact observed identities and ownership; missing evidence does not establish non-execution.

How to fix it

  • Check the request_id, task_id, operation_id and job_id sent to GET /api/agent/executions/<identity>/observation or the conversation progress endpoint: they must belong to the same conversation, the task's current or latest request and the operation's job, and must not be tombstoned. Missing evidence does not prove that work was not performed; inspect the owning conversation's receipts instead of replaying it.
  • Select a retained SMTO execution identity in the current conversation. Missing evidence does not prove that work was not performed.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm current state and correct the reported condition before requesting another attempt. Do not replay work with an unknown outcome.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported scoped selector returns the original correlated execution evidence.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained evidence or retry an operation whose effect is unknown.

Technical notes

  • Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
